remarks: Step into this luxury unit that offers refined elegance, modern design, and privacy all in the heart of downtown Darien's premier neighborhood, The Corbin District. With 1550 SF, 2 spacious bedrooms w/ ensuite baths, this residence features an open floor plan with 9' ceilings and oversized windows that provide abundant lighting. There is a private lobby dedicated to the building with an elevator from the parking garage to each floor level and the roof deck. Separate powder room, full-size laundry, and a modern custom kitchen. Just 2 blocks from the Metro North train station, this is a community that has become a destination. The Corbin District is a lifestyle change that offers carefree living surrounded by a vibrant downtown with upscale amenities. One garage parking spot included in rent. Additional garage parking spot, if available for an extra fee.
